description: Redraws ONE scene's opening picture of an episode parked at frames review (`story.stage: "frames_review"`), from the scene's own text, cast and continuity references. There is no prompt argument. WHEN: the user dislikes THE PICTURE itself (hands, framing, a face that came out wrong, a failed lane). `scene_index` is that frame's zero-based `scene_index` in `get_video`'s `story.frames`. If what HAPPENS in the scene is wrong, a redraw only buys another picture of the same rejected beat: use `change_story_scene`. AFTER: returns `image_id` (status `generating`) and a `report` to RELAY as written (redrawn from the existing text; what happens, who is in frame and the spoken lines are unchanged). This call opens its own card with the scene marked as redrawing: no `show_generation`, no narrating the wait; poll `get_video` only to see the outcome (the lane's `regenerate` entry; the frame's `url` is then the new image). A failed redraw keeps the old frame. CHECK `attached`: `false` means the image is charged but will NOT replace the frame at fire: say so and redraw again before firing. `cast_member_ids` only when the user asks who is in the frame. COST: one standard image at the series' RESOLVED start-frame model (not the model the episode was created with, and not the discounted create rate): `pricing.frame_regen_tokens` on the series' full `list_series` entry (the `series_id` call), or `estimate_only` when null. State it every time: a standing go does not cover a redraw. THE GO THIS ONE NEEDS: one redraw, one named scene, one priced ask. A complaint ('scene 3 looks off') is a reason to OFFER it, never a go; never redraw more scenes than named. A redraw is not firing. SPENDS TOKENS: price with `estimate_only: true`, ask in the SAME message as the price, and wait for a go that names THIS purchase (SPENDING RULES, this server's instructions). IDEMPOTENCY: a reused `idempotency_key` REPLAYS the first job whatever the settings: never reuse one for a new generation (this server's instructions).

cast_member_ids.description: Cast member library ids for this redraw. Omit for the scene's own cast; `[]` for no characters.

scene_index.description: The zero-based scene index exactly as `get_video`'s `story.frames` lists it (users count from ONE: 'redraw scene 2' is the SECOND frame).

name: regenerate_story_frame
title: Regenerate one story frame
